security.name: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Promos

notes: Value-weighted, chain-linked index of the set's rare+ cards at TCGplayer market prices, base 1000 on the first observed day.
provenance: Singles: MTGJSON daily vendor prices (TCGplayer, Card Kingdom, Cardmarket). Sealed: Card Kingdom sealed pricelist and TCGplayer price points, one snapshot per day since 2026-08-28. EUR converted at the ECB reference rate. No terminal data, no modelled history.
